purpose: Replace an unsupported constant-current-speed heuristic with a motion-response envelope that explicitly covers irrevocable queued targets, actuator response, geometric approximation and contact-permission transitions.
current_candidate: REJECTED_FOR_ADOPTION; two new primary-comparator geometry failures; fresh acceptance and full point-force recordings absent
hypotheses_to_separate: Momentum/actuator response after a locally retreating applied target can consume remaining clearance.
Frozen current J and velocity do not bound nonlinear future clearance.
An already-negative permitted-contact row can become a scored violation when permission is revoked.
freeze_before_launch: Complete immutable controller, simulator, asset, collision, hand-pose, load and resolved actuator-gain/effort/velocity-limit manifests.
Separate calibration/development seeds from fresh holdout seeds and hash their raw command tapes before launch.
Register strata, horizons, first-event definitions, exclusions, motion floors and all safety thresholds before observing candidate outcomes.
Any uncertainty bound must declare its source and validity domain; an observed calibration maximum alone is empirical and cannot certify an unobserved state.

calibration_grid.coverage_rule: Report realized valid-state coverage per stratum and all rejection reasons; these design coordinates are not claimed as sampled experiments or a full Cartesian workspace.

measurements: Native full joint q/qd, root pose/velocity and resolved actuator gains/limits at pre-control, pre-physics and every physics substep.
Original issued, applied and all six pending target slots; identify the first completed physics macro after each target is delivered.
All original nonexempt geometry rows and permissions, full row identities, collider-to-row correspondence and original collision observations.
Per-contact scalar normal forces plus per-partner vectors for every trial; no inference of scalar-force safety from vector norms.
For each closing row: actual approach before response, peak speed, time to nonclosing motion, remaining minimum clearance, and any velocity sign reversals.
Capture every geometry, force, permission-revocation and invalid-initial event with three wide views and hand views using the same native run.
mechanism_requirements: Forecast the irrevocable six-target queue and actuator response to a newly delivered retreat target, including the first completed response macro.
Account for acceleration, effort saturation, changing Jacobians, full collision geometry and model error instead of treating current-speed times delay as a stopping bound.
Revalidate contact permission over the response horizon; an exemption must not hide an already unsafe state at revocation.
If no validated response envelope or viable retreat exists in the registered domain, report UNKNOWN or nonviable; a static projection residual of zero cannot establish future safety.
Keep candidate implementation in an isolated version until matched regressions and fresh tests are closed.

acceptance_phases.name: CPU contract controls
acceptance_phases.scope: Queue clocks, sign conventions, finite inputs, empty/missing envelope rejection, exemption transitions, a known approach-to-retreat response counterexample and independently calculated prediction-error oracles.

acceptance_phases.name: Known-bank paired regression
acceptance_phases.scope: All original 128 cases retained; no new strict failure versus the primary baseline; all original geometry, force and motion gates remain in force; explicitly compare the two newly failed cases and five rescues.

acceptance_phases.name: Fresh native holdout
acceptance_phases.scope: New prehashed seeds, complete scalar force streams, resolved dynamics manifests, realized joint/velocity/FIFO/geometry/permission coverage, paired raw inputs and registered motion floors. Freeze sample size and failure-rate target before launch; use independent case counts rather than correlated frame/row counts for uncertainty.

acceptance_phases.name: Manipulation and load acceptance
acceptance_phases.scope: Only after native safety gates: reachable uncluttered layouts, object state/size/pose inputs, real maintained grasp, variable loads, four-arm task completion and calibrated top/front/side videos. Empty-hand trajectory safety does not pass this phase.
